column1: # Electron elastic (quasi-elastic: rotationally/vibrationally unresolved) scattering on molecules
#      'coherent' includes intramolecular interference; 'incoherent' = sum of free-atom DCS (no interference).
# Bonding correction: ratio of orientation-averaged first-Born DCS from the CCSD/aug-cc-pVTZ molecular density (PySCF; UCCSD for O2 3Sigma_g-)
#      to that from spherically averaged CCSD/aug-cc-pVTZ free-atom densities at the same geometry. Computed for theta <= 60 deg; set to 1 beyond
#      (|ratio-1| < 2e-4 at 60 deg). DCS_bonding_corrected = IAM_coherent x ratio.  T2 = H2 at this level (same r_e; nuclear mass enters only via vibrational averaging).
